name: email-preference-center
title: Email preference center
description: The page behind 'manage your emails': a frequency per list, a pause for 30 days, and unsubscribe from everything behind one inline confirmation.
docs: Works without a signed-in session: pass the address (it is shown partly masked) and save each change from onChange, which may return a promise. A list's frequencies default to Off, Weekly and Monthly. Up to four steps sit side by side (on a phone, long labels become a menu) and more than four are always a menu. The value "off" is what Unsubscribe from everything sets. Leave out onPause, onResume or onUnsubscribeAll to drop that part of the page. Controlled with value, or uncontrolled with defaultValue. title, description and headingLevel (2 or 3) rename the heading and set its level.
